text:
anya.design: Quick thought after yesterday's usability test — when multiple tool calls are in one run, the validation state is hard to scan. People missed which tool produced the mismatch.

mike.devex: Noted. Current UI attaches a long validation panel under each call. For dense runs that means lots of scrolling.

rita.product: Can we try an inline compact badge next to the tool header? Something like: [OrderV2] [!warning] then click shows a light popover with 2 sample mismatched rows.

ezra.a11y: Accessibility: the badge must be keyboard-focusable and have an accessible name like "Schema validation: OrderV2, warning". The popover should be a dialog with role=dialog or aria-modal=false and trap focus while open.

tom.runtime: Backend idea: add `validation_summary` to invocation payloads, e.g. `{ "status": "warn", "short": "missing price", "examples": [{...}] }`. Client can render the short line directly in the badge. That avoids full validation re-run on the client.

mike.devex: Love the summary. UX question: should badge be purely icon+short text or include dismissible count for examples? Proposed layout: badge = icon + short text (max 20 chars), chevron to open inspector.

anya.design: Also want a tiny diff preview in the popover: two columns, expected vs actual truncated. Like:

```
expected: { "price": number }
actual:   { "price": null }
```

Keep monospace and small. Popover should allow "Open full inspector" which anchors to the right-side inspector.

rit a.product: +1 on anchor link. We should also add a filter in run history: "Only runs with validation issues" and a quick sort to put those on top for QA. Backend can support `?validation=has_issues`.

ezra.a11y: A few more a11y notes: don't rely on color alone for status; include textual status in badge (e.g., "warning"). Announce validation changes via `aria-live="polite"` when a run finishes so screen reader users know there's a problem.

tom.runtime: Performance consideration: computing detailed diffs for every call is expensive. We'll emit lightweight summary and keep an async job for full diffs; clients show loader if user opens full inspector. We can also store a short `schema_fingerprint` to dedupe schemas.

mike.devex: Implementation plan: 1) render badge using `validation_summary.short`, 2) popover with `examples` and truncated diff, 3) inspector anchor for full diffs. Keyboard: Enter/Space opens popover, Esc closes, Up/Down navigate examples.

anya.design: Copy microcopy choices: for badge text options: "OK", "Warning", "Mismatch". Prefer verbs? maybe not. Draft tooltip: "Schema validation: Mismatch. Press Enter to inspect." Thoughts?

rita.product: Prefer nouns for status — consistent with other consoles. Use "Mismatch" and for info-level use "Partial Match" not "Warn". Also keep tooltip CTAs short: "Press Enter to inspect" works.

ezra.a11y: Tooltip must not be the only source of the instruction. Include visible hint in the popover footer: "Keyboard: Enter to open, Esc to close". Also include an ARIA description on the badge linking to that hint.

ci-bot: CI: visual diffs queued for playground-run-list + run-detail. Test run id: 20260323-14.

mike.devex: Next steps: tom will add `validation_summary` + `schema_fingerprint`; anya will mock badge + popover variants; ezra will review a11y labels; rita to confirm run-history filter priority. I'll open a small PR for the client rendering once API shape is stable.

anya.design: Cool — dropping a Figma link in the thread when mocks are ready. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
